definition: the state of being everywhere at once
memoryTip: Ubi (Latin “where”) + everywhere — so common it’s hard to escape.
correctPassage: The ubiquity of smartphones has reshaped how students research and study.
wrongPassages: The mountain’s ubiquity made it a rare landmark only locals could find.
After the store closed, the product’s ubiquity left empty shelves worldwide.
She prized the painting’s ubiquity, since no other copy existed.

memoryTip: In- (not) + noxious (harmful) — a remark that doesn’t sting.
correctPassage: What seemed an innocuous joke later made several coworkers uncomfortable.
wrongPassages: The innocuous chemical burned through the steel drum within minutes.
Police evacuated the block after detecting an innocuous gas leak.
Critics called the speech innocuous after it sparked protests in three cities.

definition: extremely complex and difficult to follow
memoryTip: Think of a volume coiled into tight twists — overly complex.
correctPassage: The contract’s convoluted clauses left neither side sure who held liability.
wrongPassages: Her convoluted explanation used one clear sentence anyone could follow.
The map was convoluted: a single straight highway with no turns.
He gave a convoluted answer that cut straight to the main point.

definition: most noticeable or important; standing out
memoryTip: From Latin salire, “to leap” — points that leap out at you.
correctPassage: The most salient finding was the sharp drop in error rates after training.
wrongPassages: The report buried its salient details where no one would notice them.
She called the typo salient and ignored the main experimental result.
His salient role meant he barely appeared in the project at all.

definition: to prevent someone from accomplishing something
memoryTip: A thwart is a cross-seat in a boat — something that blocks your path.
correctPassage: Bad weather threatened to thwart the launch for a third time.
wrongPassages: The coach’s pep talk helped thwart the team toward an easy win.
New funding will thwart the lab’s long-delayed experiment at last.
Security cameras were installed to thwart customers and make shopping smoother.
